subject: CAIQ ingest playbook and evidence onboarding
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmecloud.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Security Team <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake — initial evidence and onboarding questions

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We're starting our internal CAIQ intake for Redwood and I wanted to get a short checklist so we can schedule the artifact handoff. Specifically:

- Which control families do you expect will need runtime log samples vs. architecture diagrams?
- What format should we upload for large log dumps (parquet vs. gzipped text)?
- Any prefered owner names for queries during the ingest window?

We have a couple of attachments (sample log extract, existing security architecture diagram) — I can send them once we confirm a secure upload link.

Goal is to have an initial evidence bundle to your team by the end of next week (Jul 9). Is that timeline realistic?

Appreciate it,
Ethan
Acme Cloud — Senior Security Ops

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — initial evidence and onboarding questions

Ethan — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front then a proposed lightweight playbook below.

- Runtime logs vs diagrams: telemetry/runtime logs for the CSA sections related to audit logging, monitoring, and incident response (AIM, IVS); architecture diagrams paired with control narratives for network, identity, and segmentation controls (IAM, NET).
- Preferred log format: parquet is ideal for bulk telemetry (smaller, schema-preserving). Gzipped text is acceptable for one-off samples.
- Owner names: Kim will be the primary tracer for telemetry and uploads; Marissa will shepherd control narrative and attachments.

Attach: I'm dropping a first-pass CAIQ index (redwood-caiq-index-v2.xlsx) to illustrate our mapping schema. I'll also create a short ingest playbook we can align to your S3/secure transfer process.

Proposed onboarding playbook (high level):
1) Scope confirmation call (30 min) — confirm selected control families and data residency.
2) Temporary upload bucket + access window (we'll provide a pre-signed S3 link or share a secure Drive folder).
3) Ingest mapping template — you populate columns: artifact_type, timeframe, owner, retention_policy, notes.
4) We run a quick validation (schema checks for parquet/text) and flag missing fields.
5) Final handoff and attestation (.pdf) once validation passes.

Timeline: If you can confirm scope by Fri (Jul 2) we can accept the bundle on Jul 6 and turn around an initial mapping by Jul 9.

Let me know if you'd prefer DocuSign for the attestation or a short email-based acceptance.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-caiq-index-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmecloud.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Security Team <security@acmecloud.com>, Luz Gomez <luz.gomez@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — initial evidence and onboarding questions

Chloe — thanks, that playbook is helpful. Quick clarifications:

- Acme prefers Drive link for smaller bundles and presigned S3 for larger archives — we'll do both.
- For the ingest mapping template, can you send a filled example row so our engineers can mirror it?
- We have concerns around retention policy labels — who will be responsible for redaction guidance during the ingest?

I've attached a tiny sample log extract and our internal Evidence Intake form so you can see fields we capture. If we aim for Jul 6 upload, is it OK that Luz will be the uploader?

Thanks,
Ethan

Attachment: sample-log-extract.txt (txt); Acme-Evidence-Intake.pdf (pdf)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake — initial evidence and onboarding questions

Ethan / Luz — perfect. Actions and owners below (finalizing timeline):

- Chloe (me): share a filled example row from the mapping template and a 1-page redaction guidance note (today EOD).
- Kimberly Park: will validate sample log schema and confirm parquet schema expectations (Jul 3).
- Marissa Cole: will prepare the control-narrative template and confirm which CAIQ questions we plan to answer with each artifact (Jul 3).
- Luz Gomez (Acme): final uploader and point of contact for the secure transfer (Jul 6 upload window).

Retention guidance: we'll provide categories (short-term sample, production retention, and redaction-required). Redaction guidance will be a collaborative pass: you mark fields that need redaction in the intake form and Kim/Marissa will confirm acceptable transforms.

Upload options: we'll share a presigned S3 link by Jul 5 and a Drive folder if you need quick access.

Next meeting: 30-min scope confirmation on Mon Jul 5 at 10:00 PT — sending calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the bundle.

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ingest-playbook-draft.pdf, redaction-guidance-onepager.docx
